blocks.text: SIARGAO – Despite bowing out of the World Surf League (WSL) Championship Tour Philippines Pro, 15-year-old Filipino surfer Mara Lopez earned something more meaningful than a victory after drawing praise from world No. 1 Molly Picklum. The Australian surfing star was impressed by the young La Union native, who faced her in Round 1 and Heat 5, and saw a promising talent in Lopez capable of inspiring the next generation of Filipino surfers. Lopez finished with 4.50 points against Picklum’s 11.50 in the competition at the famed Cloud 9 reef break here Sunday morning. READ: World’s finest coming to Siargao for […]...
